title: Applied labs
description: Build, break, debug and evaluate in your own environment.

lessons.title: Lab: Reading & reproducing papers
lessons.conceptOverview: Write a reproduction checklist for one paper. Identify the principal claim, baseline, compute budget and three implementation ambiguities.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Separate a paper claim from its assumptions, implementation choices and evidence. Record datasets, preprocessing, architecture, training budget and evaluation protocol. Reproduce a small baseline before scaling the proposed method; missing details should be documented as assumptions.

sections.title: 1. Establish a baseline
sections.content: Write down your inputs, expected behavior and constraints before starting. Write a reproduction checklist for one paper. Identify the principal claim, baseline, compute budget and three implementation ambiguities.

sections.title: 2. Introduce a failure
sections.content: Test the mistaken assumption: A matching headline score proves an exact reproduction. Record the observed result and the point where it diverges from your prediction.

sections.title: 3. Debug and evaluate
sections.content: Use the mechanism to explain the failure: Separate a paper claim from its assumptions, implementation choices and evidence. Record datasets, preprocessing, architecture, training budget and evaluation protocol. Reproduce a small baseline before scaling the proposed method; missing details should be documented as assumptions. Change one variable at a time. Repeat the baseline and add a held-out case. Submit the implementation, results and limitations.

commonMistakes: A matching headline score proves an exact reproduction.
keyTakeaways: Separate a paper claim from its assumptions, implementation choices and evidence.

lessons.title: Lab: Ablations & experimental rigor
lessons.conceptOverview: Design an ablation for a new attention component. Include the unchanged baseline, parameter counts, seed policy and failure criteria.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Change one factor at a time when attributing improvements. Use held-out data, multiple seeds and uncertainty estimates. Compare against baselines under similar compute budgets. Negative results can reveal sensitivity or hidden dependencies and should remain in the experiment record.

lessons.title: Lab: Research artifacts & evaluation
lessons.conceptOverview: Package a minimal paper implementation with a reproducible command, metrics table and limitations section. Have a fresh environment rerun the evaluation.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Publish configurations, environment versions, dataset provenance and evaluation scripts with the artifact. Track licenses and privacy constraints. Separate validation used for model selection from the final test set. Report compute, limitations and deviations from the paper alongside results.
